|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Wedge Antilles (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V2-L-wedgeantilles-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-wedgeantilles022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/wedgeantilles.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual2-Light/large/wedgeantilles.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive primary-source copy].
